Global Microsoft outage: contacting Quadrant Resourcing

The global Microsoft outage is affecting our team’s email and access to some other Microsoft services.

For an urgent assignment, interview, start date, or payment enquiry, please contact Benjamin Taylor at benjamin.taylor@redquadrant.com. His email is working through a Gmail workaround. Please include the assignment or enquiry reference, any deadline, and a phone number.

We’re working on temporary business email addresses and will publish them here once they’re tested and ready. Please don’t send candidate documents, identity documents, or project information to personal email accounts.

If you’re waiting for an urgent response, please contact Benjamin or call your usual Quadrant Resourcing contact. Apologies for the disruption.
